categories.main_business_segments: PVH operates three main business segments: Tommy Hilfiger (including Tommy Hilfiger North America and International), Calvin Klein (including Calvin Klein North America and International), and Heritage Brands (primarily Warner’s, Olga, True&Co., and licensed brands, with the Heritage Brands Retail segment exited in 2021). Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein together generate over 90% of PVH's revenue, with Heritage Brands now a much smaller contributor focused on wholesale and licensing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: PVH's core operations center on in-house design and merchandising teams leveraging extensive brand archives, data analytics, and 3D design technology to create globally relevant apparel and accessories. The company sources finished products from approximately 1,100 independent factories in about 40 countries, primarily in Asia, and has implemented speed models and digital tools to enhance supply chain efficiency and responsiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: PVH serves a broad range of customers through wholesale (department stores, specialty stores, warehouse clubs, off-price retailers, and digital commerce partners), direct-to-consumer retail (company-operated stores and e-commerce), and licensing. Key end markets include men’s, women’s, and children’s apparel, underwear, accessories, and footwear, with a focus on premium and mid-tier consumers globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: PVH operates in over 40 countries, with significant business in North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region, as well as Brazil. Over 65% of revenue is generated outside the United States, with a strong presence in both developed and emerging markets. The company exited direct operations in Russia and Belarus in 2022 due to the war in Ukraine.
categories.supply_chain_position: PVH is positioned downstream in the supply chain, focusing on design, branding, marketing, and distribution of finished apparel and accessories. The company outsources manufacturing to third-party suppliers and manages a global network of warehousing and distribution centers to serve wholesale, retail, and digital channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: PVH’s strategic focus, articulated in the PVH+ Plan, is on brand-led, digital-first, and direct-to-consumer growth, with five key drivers: winning with product, consumer engagement, digitally-led marketplace, demand- and data-driven operating model, and driving efficiencies to reinvest in growth. The company is investing in digital transformation, supply chain agility, sustainability, and bringing previously licensed product categories in-house.
categories.revenue_model: PVH generates revenue primarily through product sales in wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels, complemented by royalty and advertising income from licensing its brands to third parties. In 2022, approximately 95% of revenue came from product sales, with the remainder from licensing and advertising fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: PVH competes with global and regional apparel companies, including both branded and private label players, such as Ralph Lauren, Levi Strauss, VF Corporation, and fast fashion and digital-native brands. The company is positioned as a leader in premium and lifestyle apparel, leveraging the global recognition of Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein to differentiate itself in a highly competitive, fashion-driven industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2022, PVH generated $9.0 billion in revenue, with a workforce of approximately 31,000 associates. The company rebounded from a pandemic-driven revenue decline in 2020 ($7.1 billion), with 2021 and 2022 showing stabilization and modest contraction due to currency headwinds and the Russia exit. PVH maintains significant international exposure and expects low single-digit revenue growth in 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: PVH’s value proposition centers on iconic, globally recognized brands (Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein) offering high-quality, stylish, and culturally relevant products across multiple price points and channels. The company emphasizes brand authenticity, digital engagement, sustainability, and a diversified product and geographic mix to reduce reliance on any single market or demographic.
